[[File:Brassican Mage chathead.png|left]]
'''Brassican Mages''' are followers of [[Brassica Prime]], being among the few known followers of the cabbage deity in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''.

They appear while doing [[Clue scroll (master)|master clue scrolls]] when the player digs for a clue directed by the [[strange device]] or [[coordinates]] in [[single-way combat]] areas. They attack with [[Typeless]] [[Magic]]{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1234494540670742528|date=2 March 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105592|archivedate=15 August 2021|quote=[How is the Brassican Mage's attack roll calculated, and what defence style does it roll against?] Standard magical accuracy roll against your magical defence.}} and as such it cannot be nullified by [[protection prayers]]. They may call out "Rest in cabbage!" or "Vegetate!", among other things, upon appearing.

==Strategy==
Brassican Mages have low [[Defence]], so melee or ranged is advised. Magic is not advised as they are resistant due to their high Magic level. Because a player cannot pray against a Brassican Mage's attack, having plenty of [[food]] before the fight is essential, especially if encountering it via the strange device as it damages the player after every use. Wearing high Magic defence armour such as [[Karil the Tainted's equipment|Karil's]] or [[Black dragonhide armour|black dragonhide]] will help defend against its attack. It is recommended to use a weapon with a strong special attack, such as a [[Dragon dagger]].

Although protection prayers do not work against them, it can be useful to use defensive prayers such as [[Steel Skin]] to increase your overall defence. It is even more useful to use [[Piety]] or [[Rigour]] (depending on combat style) to increase both your defence and your melee/range stats.

Wearing [[rings of recoil]] or a charged [[ring of suffering]] is useful in deflecting some damage back onto the Mage. Low level players might want to try poisoning the Mage and hiding behind an obstacle. 

For Brassican Mages fought in the [[Wilderness]], only bring items you are prepared to lose. The fast, typeless attacks can deal a lot of damage very quickly, so it is very easy to die in a short period of time.

==Trivia==
*If the player eats a [[cabbage]] while fighting a Brassican Mage, the mage will say one of various lines praising the player for choosing to eat cabbages. <!--also occurs when eating draynor manor cabbage-->
*The Brassican Mage's name comes from the genus {{wp|Brassica}}, which includes cabbage.
*The mage wields a [[cabbage round shield]], which is a possible reward from medium [[Treasure Trails]].
*The Brassican Mage's dialogue "Die deliciously!" is a reference to the 2015 film {{Wp|The Witch (2015 film)|The Witch}}.
